subject: mathematics
content: Let the equation of the plane passing through the line $$x - 2y - z - 5 = 0 = x + y + 3z - 5$$ and parallel to the line $$x + y + 2z - 7 = 0 = 2x + 3y + z - 2$$ be $$ax + by + cz = 65$$. Then the distance of the point (a, b, c) from the plane $$2x + 2y - z + 16 = 0$$ is ____________.
